# Phase 6 — Gate 2: final review + production check (Tue 6 Oct, noon)

**Goal:** prove the spec's Definition of Done on the live URL.

**Checklist**
- [ ] New user registers (Google), connects GitHub, builds profile, adds projects, previews, submits
- [ ] Admin approves; card appears in the public carousel
- [ ] Card flips (mouse, touch, keyboard); carousel drags, swipes, snaps
- [ ] QR opens the public member page from a real phone; links work
- [ ] Edit after approval → public card unchanged until re-approved
- [ ] PWA installs; mobile and desktop layouts usable; DAY and NIGHT
- [ ] Data persists across sessions and devices
- [ ] Protected routes enforced; `/admin` refused for members (UI and RPC)
- [ ] No secrets in the bundle or repo (`git grep`, `grep dist`)
- [ ] Loading, empty and error states seen on every route
- [ ] Google consent screen In production; tested with an account that isn't yours
- [ ] Keepalive workflow green
- [ ] AEGIS Council on the finished app → CLEAR or HOLD with only accepted items
- [ ] README: what it is, live URL, screenshots, how to run, credits

Afternoon is buffer for fixes found here only.
